common.proof_boundary: Catalogue consistency only; no authentication, authorization, transition, privacy, durability, browser or acceptance proof.

D01.question: Reserve exact route/method/secret-proof carrier only after runtime collision and privacy review; RFC0131 currently reserves none.

D02.question: Verify provider-to-Account/intended-contact recovery and attributable issuer chain; specify registry bootstrap/configuration/recovery authority.

D03.question: Define actual request/response schemas, exact allowed fields, identifier syntax, protected projection and cursor bindings; record shapes are not DTOs.

D04.question: Review exact HTTP statuses/error codes, non-enumerating bodies/timing, abuse/rate/response limits and audit amplification bounds.

D05.question: Specify idempotency-key carrier/representation/retention, actor-operation-scope-payload binding, changed-payload refusal and compare-and-set/version conflicts.

D06.question: Adopt finite lifetimes/retention and browser/delivery/redirect protections separately; RFC values and record bounds remain proposals.

D07.question: Qualify a canonical-control-plane durable adapter, atomic transitions, ambiguous-commit recovery, backup freshness and output-fence linearization; select no new provider here.

D08.question: Review study-access/0.1 registration, wire-version negotiation/refusal, credential typing/audience and numeric representations including audit versions.

D09.question: Record compatibility/data/research/security/migration/validation/rollback decisions and separate publication approval from RFC acceptance/runtime authority.

D10.question: Bind the grant expiry offered before acceptance to invitation/request/response and durable transition; current Invitation shape alone does not encode the full offer.

operations.admission: Verified HumanPrincipal, current active exact study/world grant, study.setup.read and current projection policy; authenticate and authorize before protected existence or partition lookup.
operations.success: Return an explicitly allowlisted readiness projection, not the full study or grant record; operational_authority remains not_conferred. A missing-consent indicator may disclose only an already-authorized non-sensitive prerequisite status.
operations.refusal: Wrong identity/scope, revoked or expired grant, unavailable/stale authority, or failed output fence yields no protected projection. Contacts, roster, audit, private bodies and hidden-study existence remain excluded.
operations.replay: A read retry rechecks current authority and consent; neither cached projection nor retained signed claims override revocation.
operations.version_rule: Read current grant authorization_version and current projection policy at use and output time; response/version binding remains undecided.
